item.title: Fair Haven Cleaning Pro Builds A “House Of Hope”
item.description: You may have seen a House of Hope Cleaning Crew van with a yellow house tooling around the city lately. It’s more than just a cleaning company. It's in service of a larger dream, a house for young people to find direction, for anyone in need of a fresh start or a second chance. item.title: “The Most Important Tool, The Most Dangerous Tool”: How NHPS Is Adapting To AI
item.description: When Ryan Boroski opened Google Classroom to grade his students’ five-paragraph essays, he had three other tabs on standby: Scribbr, ZeroGPT, and GPTZero, all artificial intelligence (AI) detection software. Since the Covid-19 pandemic, the Co-op social studies teacher said, AI use has “gotten so bad I now run every essay through AI checkers.” The post “The Most Important Tool, The Most Dangerous Tool”: How NHPS Is Adapting To AI appeared first on New Haven Independent.
